definitions.explanation: An Olympic track and field event in which athletes walk as fast as possible while maintaining continuous contact with the ground. One foot must always be on the ground.

examples.japanese: {競歩|きょうほ}の{選手|せんしゅ}が{練習|れんしゅう}している。
{競歩|きょうほ}は{走|はし}ると{失格|しっかく}になる{競技|きょうぎ}だ。
examples.english: Race walking is a sport where you get disqualified if you run.

examples.japanese: オリンピックの{競歩|きょうほ}で{日本|にほん}の{選手|せんしゅ}が{金|きん}メダルを{獲得|かくとく}した。
examples.english: A Japanese athlete won a gold medal in Olympic race walking.

notes:
USAGE:
An Olympic event with strict rules: one foot must be in contact with the ground at all times, and the supporting leg must be straight when the foot touches the ground. Judges can issue warnings or disqualify athletes who violate these rules.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {競歩|きょうほ}{選手|せんしゅ} (race walking athlete)
- 20キロ{競歩|きょうほ} (20km race walk)
- {競歩|きょうほ}{大会|たいかい} (race walking competition)
